observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Large indoor arena stage with glossy floor featuring a Red Bull logo, surrounded by a seated audience and cameras.
observation.dancers: Individual male dancers competing solo in turn, wearing casual streetwear.
observation.formation_and_space: Solo dancer in the center of the stage facing the judges and audience.
observation.posture: Athletic and upright with bent knees, shifting weight quickly between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, slides, quick shuffles, and foot drops synchronized with the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing, pump, or gesticulate dynamically; occasionally arms support body weight during floor transitions.
observation.hips_and_torso: Bends, bounces, and isolations in the torso coordinated with footwork and floor moves.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent changes in levels from upright dancing to floor drops, knee spins, and jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: T-shirts, loose trousers, and sneakers; no hand props.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact subtlest nuances of foot articulation due to wide camera angles and rapid movement.

signature_moments.what: Dancer drops to the floor into a spin/freeze combination on the beat
A high jump followed by a quick drop to the floor and spin
Rapid foot shuffle changing levels into a low stance freeze
